exposure: Pregnant women with pre-existing diabetes, pregnant women with gestational diabetes
outcome: Maternal outcomes (pre-eclampsia, Caesarean section, future diabetes, cardiovascular complications)
Fetal outcomes (congenital anomalies, stillbirth, macrosomia, birth trauma, hypoglycemia, long-term effects)
finding: The guideline provides recommendations for the diagnosis and management of diabetes in pregnancy, emphasizing the importance of multidisciplinary management, optimal blood sugar control, and appropriate fetal surveillance to improve outcomes for both mothers and offspring.
gest_age: Variable, recommendations from 24-28 weeks gestation onwards
